These planets, designated PSR B1257+12 b and PSR B1257+12 c (with a third planet PSR B1257+12 d also confirmed), were discovered by Aleksander Wolszczan and Dale Frail in 1992. The detection was made possible by observing tiny variations in the pulsar's radio pulse timing caused by the gravitational influence of the orbiting planets.
